name: World of Pannotia: Looting Shulker Shells
summary: Shulkers drop 2 extra shulker shells per kill, plus 0-2 more per level of Looting, on top of the vanilla chance.

mechanics.title: Extra shells
mechanics.description: Unconditional pool added to the vanilla table: exactly 2 Shulker Shells, plus a uniform 0-2 per Looting level. No killed-by-player requirement. Vanilla still separately gives 1 shell with 50% chance (56.25% at Looting I, +6.25% per level above I).

vanilla_changes.change: Guaranteed 2 Shulker Shells (+0-2 per Looting level) added to the vanilla 50%-chance single shell.

editor_notes: The module also contains tags/item/shulker_shell.json in its own namespace with an empty value list; it has no effect. Shulker also has a 5% head drop from more_mob_heads.
